review.tagline: Python agent harness with sub-agents, filesystem tools and context management
review.summary: Deep Agents is a Python library whose create_deep_agent() returns a ready-to-run agent built on LangChain's create_agent and LangGraph. It bundles planning, sub-agents with isolated context, a pluggable filesystem and shell backend, context summarization, skills, human-in-the-loop approval and persistent memory. It works with any tool-calling LangChain chat model, including Ollama, vLLM and llama.cpp.
review.audience: Python developers building long-running, tool-using agents on LangChain
strengths: Sub-agents, filesystem, context summarization and skills are bundled and work out of the box
Any LangChain chat model with tool calling works, including Ollama, vLLM and llama.cpp
Any LangGraph CompiledStateGraph can be passed in as a sub-agent
Human-in-the-loop approval of tool calls; tools can be custom functions or MCP servers
weaknesses: Opinionated defaults sit on top of LangChain and LangGraph, adding layers to learn
Trust-the-LLM security model: boundaries must be enforced via tools or sandbox
Tracing and evaluation are documented around LangSmith, a separate hosted product
Python only here; the JavaScript version is a separate repository
needs: Needs LangChain, LangGraph, LLM provider or local model server
Models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Baseten, Fireworks
